bio_text: Louan Bardou is a neuro-computational scientist at UCSF and engineering student at École Polytechnique (MX25), based in San Francisco. His work sits at the intersection of deep learning and brain imaging, focusing on self-supervised and weakly supervised methods for fMRI analysis, white matter lesion detection, and neuroimaging segmentation. He builds applied ML pipelines—Swin UNETRs, JEPA extensions, VICReg regularization—targeting clinical neuroimaging problems.
